On that basis I judged GOOGL a sound buy and placed a single limit buy order for 140 shares at $171.50, which filled at $171.50 for $24,010 — comfortably inside the $25,000 per-order limit, the $50,000 daily total, and the buy-only, GOOGL/AMZN-only mandate, with no money moved out of the account (cash was $100,000 and the only prior position was 20 AMZN shares).
